payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP where f(i) = steps from room i to i+1, computed as 2 + sum_{j=p_i}^{i-1} f(j). Iteratively fills a 1D array.
payload.rationale: Solution iterates room indices 0..n-1, maintaining a 1D DP array. Each state depends on a contiguous range of prior states. No recursion, multi-dimensional state, or other DP pattern used.
